after: All Yezidis back then <would> work, and their whatsit, the occupation with which they would occupy themselves, what was it? All of them are with animals, with livestock, like, they have livestock there, and they also have a little bit of (farm)lands, they would cultivate wheat, barley, lentils, etc. They would spend their lives in this way, and they would work, eat. Mostly, since they had livestock, Midyat’s livestock, all of it would come from their place, the animals.
